title: CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 14-10, Series # 1 Of Corrections, Additions, Deletions And/Or Updates

sections.title: CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 14-10, SERIES # 1 OF CORRECTIONS, ADDITIONS, DELETIONS AND/OR UPDATES
sections.content_text:
DATE: 09-24-2010
Manual:
Aged, Blind, and Disabled Medicaid
Change No:
14-10
To:
County Directors of Social Services
Effective:
10-01-2010

sections.title: I. BACKGROUND
sections.content_text: This is the first of a series of change notices being compiled containing various ABD Medicaid manual section corrections, additions, deletions and/or updates that were not included or not updated within the Medicaid policy at publication.

sections.title: II. CONTENT OF CHANGE
sections.content_text:
The Table of Contents is updated to include all manual sections.
The manuals sections are revised as follows:

sections.title: A. MA-2306, Application Processing-Corrective Action Procedures, is revised to:
sections.content_text: Correct the fax number and mailing address for the Medicaid Application Monitoring Unit.
